Wir bei nutri+ glauben an eine Welt, in der Tiere respektiert werden und niemand zurückgelassen wird. Deshalb setzen wir uns nicht nur für hochwertige vegane Produkte ein, sondern unterstützen aktiv den Tier- und Umweltschutz.

Unsere Marke ist dabei weit mehr als unsere Produkte. Wir möchten Menschen begeistern, Orientierung geben und zeigen, wer hinter nutri+ steht. Dafür suchen wir Dich als Brand Manager (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Brand, PR und Personal Branding.

Deine Mission

Als Brand Manager (m/w/d) entwickelst Du unsere Marke strategisch weiter und sorgst dafür, dass nutri+ klar, authentisch und wiedererkennbar wahrgenommen wird.

Du definierst, wofür unsere Marke steht, welche Zielgruppen wir ansprechen und welche Geschichten wir erzählen. Gleichzeitig baust Du unser Personal Branding auf und gibst nutri+ als Unternehmen und Arbeitgeber ein Gesicht.

Dabei machst Du unsere Geschäftsführung und ausgewählte Teammitglieder als authentische Markenbotschafter:innen sichtbar und zeigst, welche Menschen, Werte und Überzeugungen hinter nutri+ stehen.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unsere Markenstrategie, Positionierung, Zielgruppen und Kernbotschaften weiter
  • Du sorgst für eine konsistente und wiedererkennbare Kommunikation über alle relevanten Kanäle hinweg
  • Du entwickelst relevante Themen, Geschichten und Kommunikationsanlässe für unsere Marke
  • Du baust unsere PR- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit auf und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Medien, Partner:innen und externen Dienstleister:innen
  • Du entwickelst eine Personal-Branding-Strategie für unsere Geschäftsführung und ausgewählte Teammitglieder
  • Du unterstützt unsere Markenbotschafter:innen bei der Themenfindung, Positionierung und Content-Planung
  • Du erstellst strategische Briefings und arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing- und Design-Team zusammen
  • Du beobachtest Markt, Zielgruppen und Wettbewerb und leitest daraus relevante Themen und Chancen für unsere Marke ab
  • Du analysierst die Wirkung unserer Markenkommunikation und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Brand Management, in der Markenkommunikation, PR oder einer vergleichbaren Position
  • Du verstehst, wie Marken aufgebaut, positioniert und langfristig weiterentwickelt werden
  • Du teilst unsere Werte & Philosophie (!) - idealerweise hast Du sogar Bezug zum Thema Tierschutz
  • Du hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Zielgruppen, Storytelling und relevante Kommunikationsthemen
  • Du kannst komplexe Inhalte in klare, verständliche und emotionale Botschaften übersetzen
  • Du arbeitest strategisch, eigenständig und bringst gleichzeitig eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenbringen und arbeitest gerne eng mit Marketing, Design und Geschäftsführung zusammen
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein ausgezeichnetes Sprachgefühl
  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran mit, einen neuen Bereich aktiv aufzubauen
  • Du hast einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote – arbeite von überall in Deutschland
  • ein Bruttojahresgehalt von 50.000 - 65.000 € bei Vollzeit und 40 Stunden, abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation
  • 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr
  • eine neu geschaffene Position mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • die Möglichkeit, unsere Marke, PR und das Personal Branding von Grund auf mit aufzubauen
  • eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Geschäftsführung
  • ein motiviertes, engagiertes Team mit einer gemeinsamen Mission
  • regelmäßige Team-Events
  • monatliche Sachbezüge über Edenred
  • attraktive Mitarbeiter-Rabatte
  • die Möglichkeit, einen direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg eines nachhaltig ausgerichteten Unternehmens zu nehmen

Du findest Dich hier wieder und hast Lust, unserer Marke und den Menschen hinter nutri+ eine starke Stimme und ein authentisches Gesicht zu geben?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt direkt bei unserer COO Svenja!

Schicke uns Deine kompletten Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Anschreiben inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Einstiegsdatum sowie Zeugnissen zu.

Franchise Brand President

Role Details
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Location: On-site (Huntersville, NC) or remote
Employment type: Full-time, exempt
Travel: Approximately 25%, based on business needs

About Us
Based in Huntersville, NC, Homefront Brands is an established platform for franchised property services businesses in North America. We have 6 brands (and growing) operating on our platform. Our mission is to be the growth engine for aspiring entrepreneurs, established business builders and our veterans to create and enhance the American dream of building a better future, through the application of our world class franchise models.

About the Opportunity

HomeFront Brands is seeking an accomplished Franchise Brand President to lead a home services franchise brand within the HomeFront Brands platform. This executive will have full accountability for the brand’s strategy, performance, franchisee success, and long-term enterprise value.
The Brand President will set a clear vision, build organizational alignment, and translate platform capabilities into profitable growth at the brand and franchisee levels. The successful candidate will combine proven brand-president leadership with deep home services experience and a strong understanding of franchise operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead brand strategy and performance: Establish the vision, strategic priorities, annual operating plan, and performance expectations for the brand.
  • Own the business: Maintain accountability for revenue growth, profitability, unit economics, budget performance, and long-term brand value.
  • Champion franchisee success: Build trusted relationships with franchise owners and ensure the organization delivers effective support, coaching, tools, and systems.
  • Drive same-store growth: Improve lead generation, sales conversion, pricing, service delivery, labor productivity, customer retention, and local market execution.
  • Accelerate network expansion: Partner with franchise development and onboarding teams to support responsible territory growth and strong new-unit performance.
  • Build a high-performing team: Recruit, develop, and retain leaders who demonstrate accountability, collaboration, urgency, and a franchisee-first mindset.
  • Leverage the HomeFront Brands platform: Collaborate across shared services and partner brands to maximize capabilities, share best practices, and create operating leverage.
  • Protect the brand: Uphold brand standards, customer experience expectations, legal and regulatory requirements, and system-wide consistency.
  • Use data to lead: Establish meaningful operating metrics, identify performance gaps, and take decisive action based on business intelligence and field insights.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Brand President, with accountability for the overall performance of a brand or business unit.
  • Demonstrated executive leadership experience in the home services industry.
  • Experience scaling a multi-location service business across multiple markets.
  • Proven success leading growth, profitability, operational improvement, and organizational change.
  • Strong command of business and financial drivers, including budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, and performance management.
  • Experience building productive relationships with franchisees, operators, field teams, and cross-functional partners.
  • Track record of developing high-performing teams and creating a culture of accountability.
  • Success using shared-service or platform capabilities to accelerate brand performance.
  • Excellent communication, judgment, executive presence, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support franchisees, employees, and brand priorities.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and executive experience.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Brand President will create strategic clarity, strengthen franchisee confidence, improve operating discipline, and build a durable path to profitable growth. Performance will be reflected in healthy franchisee economics, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, unit growth, and consistent brand execution.

HomeFront Brands is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace.

  • Experience working with event or talent agencies, roadshows, event promotions, insurance or property sales, or an established network of KOLs, creators, brands and event partners will be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with social media planning, AI tools, content editing or managing multiple events and partnerships for established brands will be an added advantage.

﻿

The Role

As PR Manager, Performance for Global HOKA Brand Communications, you’ll lead the development and execution of global public relations strategies for performance product launches and brand campaigns. You’ll drive integrated PR strategies, messaging frameworks, and communications plans, collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize global brand awareness and engagement. Your work will shape the narrative for HOKA’s performance products, elevate the brand’s presence, and ensure consistent storytelling across markets.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

  • Create integrated global PR strategies, messaging frameworks, and communications plans for product launches and brand initiatives
  • Lead campaign planning, storytelling development, and cross-functional alignment with Global Marketing, Product, Sports Marketing, and regional teams
  • Identify media opportunities, partnerships, and activations that drive global brand awareness and engagement
  • Lead PR strategy and execution for global events, races, product launches, and media experiences
  • Coordinate media attendance, spokesperson preparation, and onsite communications support
  • Partner with regional teams to ensure consistent execution and maximize earned media opportunities
  • Oversee proactive media outreach, interview coordination, and press responses across global markets
  • Manage HOKA's global PR agency network, including strategic direction, campaign execution, and performance
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with key performance, lifestyle, fitness, and trade media
  • Track global PR KPIs including media coverage, impressions, share of voice, and placement quality
  • Prepare executive reporting and campaign recaps with actionable insights
  • Manage PR budget forecasting, accruals, reconciliation, and vendor coordination with Finance
  • Manage and mentor direct report(s), providing coaching, feedback, and professional development
  • Serve as the primary communications partner across internal stakeholders and regional teams

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of PR/communications experience, ideally within consumer, performance, or lifestyle brands with global scope; agency or in-house experience welcomed
  • A strong network of media relationships across performance running, fitness, lifestyle, and outdoor verticals, with international media experience a plus
  • Proven ability to develop and execute integrated global PR campaigns from strategy through measurement
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with fluency in brand voice and editorial instincts that cut through across markets
  • Experience managing global agency networks and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Data-driven mindset: comfort translating KPIs and insights into actionable global communications strategy
  • Passion for the running and active lifestyle space — you understand the culture, the community, and what moves people around the world
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across time zones and regions without losing attention to detail
  • Budget management experience and comfort with financial forecasting and reconciliation across markets
  • Willingness to travel internationally for events, activations, and races
  • Demonstrate authenticity, champion diverse and effective teams, drive strategy, cultivate innovation, deliver results, and build connection

What We'll Give You –

  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands.   • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Partner closely with Regional Marketing, Content, Digital Experience and Product Marketing to understand objectives and deliver effective creative solutions.

Brand Quality & Evolution

  • Experience developing brand guidelines, design standards, templates and scalable creative systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple creative projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience working with external creative agencies, freelancers and production partners.

    Create clear, distinctive messaging that communicates the quality of HeyDelegate’s talent, matching process, ongoing support and value as a long-term staffing partner.

    Develop integrated brand and marketing campaigns that build awareness, credibility and trust among US-based agencies and other target clients.

  11. Performance Measurement

  • Strong understanding of brand positioning, audience segmentation, messaging architecture and campaign strategy.
  • Experience translating brand strategy into content, websites, email campaigns, case studies and sales materials.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Candidates with backgrounds in brand strategy, advertising strategy, account planning, integrated marketing or strategic communications are encouraged to apply.
